Expect about 13 of the next 14 days above 10 mg/L (chance on day 14: 93%). Soil moisture is much higher than usual for this time of year (root-zone wetness at the 100th percentile of 2016-2025), the last 7 days brought 0 mm of rain (lower than usual), and satellite bare cropland is at the 10th percentile. No weather forecast is used: a big storm would push nitrate outside this range. In 2023-2025 tests this outlook beat 'no change' by 19% (1 week) and 24% (2 weeks) in squared error.
